scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. A 2-of-3 vault: you hold two keys (home + safe-deposit box); a professional co-signer holds the third under an agreed recovery process. Your letter of instruction, stored with your will, explains how your executor works with the co-signer. No single document contains enough to steal the funds.
